notes: rule 11: the scene «كان عند أبي عبد الله عليه السلام جماعة» has the Imam speak and act ("يا هشام", "هذا والله مكتوب"); he is not added as a link, and whether he is a source of the report needs a ruling
the first link «أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation
the last link is Yunus b. Yaʿqub, whose account the report is; the two Yunuses are different men and not merged
